item.title: 129[sup]th[/sup] Annual General Meeting
item.description: The Minerals Council South Africa hosted its 129th Annual General Meeting.

item.title: Stop abuse of women
item.description: In this month when International Women’s Day is celebrated, the Minerals Council South Africa has launched the “Stop abuse of women” campaign to address sexual and gender-based violence and harassment on South Africa’s mines and in mining and labour-sending communities.

item.title: Women in mining in South Africa
item.description: Women working in the mining industry should have the same opportunities open to them as men, and must be safe to pursue them.

item.title: Minerals Council position on COVID-19
item.description: The Minerals Council South Africa recognises the novel COVID-19 pandemic as a serious threat to South Africa, and her people. We are fully supportive of the measures announced by President Cyril Ramaphosa to prevent the spread of COVID-19, and the efforts by government to manage this unprecedented crisis.

item.title: 130[sup]th[/sup] Annual General Meeting
item.description: Minerals Council President Mxolisi Mgojo has called on all the leaders of the mining industry to commit to continuing to address the COVID-19 health threat with uncompromising vigour.

item.title: National Day of Health and Safety in Mining 2020
item.description: The Minerals Council South Africa today launched the National Day of Health & Safety in Mining 2020. This is the third annual day that is being commemorated.

item.title: Minerals Council supports B4SA initiative to revitalise SA economy and mining post COVID-19
item.description: The Minerals Council South Africa supports the accelerated economic strategy developed under the auspices of B4SA aimed at achieving much higher levels of inclusive economic growth to recover from the COVID-19 crisis, and the economic crisis that preceded it.

item.title: Building Human Rights capacity among member companies
item.description: In order to guide the compliance of the mining industry in the area of human rights, the Minerals Council developed a Human Rights Framework that was approved by the Board in December 2018.

item.title: National Day of Women in Mining 2020
item.description: The Minerals Council South Africa launched the first National Day of Women in Mining highlighting its focus on the implementation of initiatives designed to achieve stretch targets for the representation and advancement of women in the South African mining industry.
